name: womenswear_revenue
sql:
SELECT
  ROUND(SUM(sale_price), 2) AS total_revenue
FROM (
  SELECT
    __oi.*
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` AS __oi
  WHERE
    __oi.product_id IN (
      SELECT
        __p.id
      FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.products` AS __p
      WHERE
        __p.department IN ('Women')
    )
) AS order_items
WHERE
  status IN ('Complete', 'Shipped')
LIMIT 1000
